title: Sonic Handoff Checklist and Regional Simulant Log
summary: Compact operational checklist for a fast ("sonic") handoff plus a short schedule of regional traffic simulants to exercise routing and latency rollback logic. Designed as a pocket reference for on-call and launch crew during 2–6h mini-rollouts.
body:
Purpose:
A minimal, high-signal checklist to guide a rapid handoff (sonic) between release conductor and the overnight/watch crew, and a small regional simulant schedule to validate traffic routing, model fallbacks, and latency rollback behavior. This is intentionally compact so it can be printed or pasted into the shift channel.

Scope and when to use:
- Use for small feature flips and config rollouts that target <10% traffic per region, or for targeted model-swaps with a rapid verification window.
- Not intended for large-scale capacity changes, DB migrations, or cross-region failovers.

Pre-handoff quick validations (5–15m):
1) Confirm build and artifact: release-tag and manifest present in release registry (release-tag: R2026-08-10-sonic).
2) Smoke deploy in staging: golden smoke test passed within last 30m (smoke-id: smoke/sonic-2026-08-10).
3) Telemetry health: all core metrics green for 1h (p95 latency, 5xx rate, queue depth).
4) Canary health: existing canary region stable and within thresholds for 30m.
5) Capacity headroom: GPU pool free capacity >20% or burst policy enabled.
6) Key stakeholders paged with summary and ETA in the release channel.

Sonic handoff script (conductor -> on-call):
- Conductor: read out (1) release-tag, (2) target region(s) & rollout percentage, (3) expected intermediate checks and durations, (4) immediate rollback conditions (explicit triggers).
- On-call: acknowledge and repeat back the rollback triggers and the primary contact.
- Conductor: start 0%->5% traffic shift and annotate change-id in chat.
- On-call: monitor the 2m and 10m snapshots, report pass/fail.
- Conductor: if pass, nudge to 25% for 15m; if pass, continue incremental schedule.

Rollback triggers (must be explicit every handoff):
- p95 latency by route increases >80% relative to baseline and remains high for 3 consecutive 1m buckets.
- 5xx rate >0.5% absolute for >5m or spike >200% over baseline.
- Error patterns matching known regressions (model OOM, KV corruption, cache invalidation alerts).
- Customer-facing signals (pager, support escalation) indicating functional regression.
- Observability gaps: if critical telemetry fails to report for >2m.

Pocket observability queries and dashboards to watch (copy/paste into ops chat):
- API: rate(ingress_requests_total[1m]) by route
- Latency: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, route))
- Errors: sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[1m])) by (route)
- GPU memory pressure: max(gpu_memory_used_bytes) by (instance)
checklist_items: Confirm release tag present in registry: R2026-08-10-sonic
Verify staging smoke-id smoke/sonic-2026-08-10 PASS within last 30m
Confirm telemetry streams active (latency, errors, queue depth)
Document immediate rollback triggers in the chat thread
Annotate change-id and link to deploy job in the channel
Run regional simulant schedule (see Simulant Log) and validate routing/fallbacks
If any trigger fires, execute rollback play: revert routing and scaledown canary pool
regional_simulant_log: Region: us-west-2 — 2026-08-10T23:00Z — 5m burst @ 20rps — purpose: validate local routing & model variant fallback
Region: eu-central-1 — 2026-08-10T23:10Z — 3m burst @ 10rps — purpose: exercise cross-AZ routing and latency SLOs
Region: ap-southeast-1 — 2026-08-10T23:25Z — 2m burst @ 8rps — purpose: cold-start / prefix cache hit-rate sampling
Region: us-east-1 — 2026-08-10T23:35Z — 10m ramp 0->25% traffic — purpose: incremental canary watch and throughput stability
post_release_observations_and_actions: T+2m: check p95 and 5xx by route; tag snapshot in chat (snapshot-id: sld-20260810-t2)
T+10m: run quick-eval prompt set against canary instances and compare perplexity/regressions (eval job link in artifacts)
T+30m: confirm cost metrics stable (token/second and GPU utilization within expected band)
T+60m: run retention note — convert key metrics to incident template if rollback occurred
notes_to_self: Keep the scope narrow: if the rollout touches model compilation or quantization paths, escalate to a full launch plan. For sonic handoffs, prefer explicit short windows and concrete telemetry cutoffs. Use the simulant bursts to exercise routing layers — don't conflate simulant errors with model quality regressions. Document any flaky telemetry as an observability action item.
postmortem_template_hint: If rollback occurs capture: change-id, timestamps, trigger condition, human decisions, mitigation steps, and follow-ups (confluence link template: CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-POSTMORTEM-XXXX)
file_version_notes: v0.1 draft: initial compact checklist and three-region simulant schedule. Will expand with automation bindings and direct dashboard links after dry run.
